objective: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

description: A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine.  We have not heard from them.
They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed.  Find these Deathstalkers.
Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine.  You should begin your search there.
completion: You found us! And not a moment too soon...
